diagnosis.original_evidence: User observed gameplay rank/HUD elements left-eye-only or head-locked in Quest3; native game FVF 0x142 fixed-function sprites were submitted via more than one GPU Draw family, while the prior exact R30 owner supported only an indexed primitive path.
source_trace: Original R84 sprite source sets native fixed-function draw, source scope, and live FVF/vertex shader before R33's Draw destination hooks.

Prior R30SupportTryFixedFunctionProjectedRankIndexed handled one indexed source while R33 nonindexed and both UP destinations did not call the corresponding fixed-function original sprite stereo route.

Material commit 5343d2c0 adds R30TryFixedFunctionOriginalSpriteStereo shared executor and invokes it from R33 DrawPrimitive/IndexedPrimitive/PrimitiveUP/IndexedPrimitiveUP with fail-closed original game fallback.
diagnosis.root_cause: R84 original native fixed-function FVF142 ScreenHud producer and rank-adjacent sprite routes were not consistently admitted to the R30 per-eye submission across nonindexed/UP physical draw families, leaving potential single-eye native draw paths.
alternatives_rejected: Do not promote every FVF142 draw to HUD without live source, queue, render target and shader checks; world/FX must remain conservative.
Do not globally Flush D3DX queues, mutate original sprite animation, or suppress native fallback/FFB/SkyGlow.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material source commit 5343d2c0 introduces shared native R30 stereo executor, four guarded R33 route hooks, rank source-owner predicate, C++ negative smoke and source mutation guard.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: FVF142 route source-mutation and native rank-owner smoke were added; automated exact-SHA full gate still pending after initial failed run #39054934011 (missing run record).
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R30 submits per-eye only when source scope, live FVF and shader, backbuffer, pose and exact marker/pause ownership qualify; invalid inputs retain the original native draw.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: No matching Quest3/VDXR headset rerun; optical correctness is unverified.
